goal: Add UpCloud as a complete third provider alongside DigitalOcean and Vultr through the existing shared proxy, scheduler, provisioning, Sanaei, Reality, residential and expiry lifecycle.
context: User explicitly requests full parity and live deployment. Official API https://developers.upcloud.com/1.3 uses bearer API tokens, resource_limits for cores/memory/public_ipv4/storage, Ubuntu templates, raw SSH public keys in create login_user, IPv4-only networking, unique durable labels for create adoption after ambiguous response. Delete requires stopped server and storages deletion; ensure idempotent read-before-retry and do not leave billable owned disks. Preserve DO/Vultr behavior and active permanent fleet residential profile. Shared driver interfaces/registry are authoritative. No UpCloud account/credential supplied yet: implement and verify contract/fault/PostgreSQL/UI; no fake live provider success, no unsolicited paid canary. Use bounded timeouts, same account egress gateway (never bypass proxy), redacted credentials, no browser login. Compute multi-resource plan-aware capacity and label estimate appropriately; do not invent exact limits or saturate probe. Source based on canonical 8ee857c. Manual reviewed implementation with OpenAI planning. Tests must cover pagination completeness, unknown creates adoption, async stop/delete, notfound, 401/403/429/5xx, capacity and parity regressions.
commit_message: feat(providers): integrate UpCloud with shared lifecycle
